apps.name: Spotify
apps.summary: Millions of songs and podcasts for free.
apps.description: Spotify is the world's most popular music streaming service with over 500 million users. Listen to millions of songs, podcasts, and audiobooks. Create playlists, discover new music, and enjoy personalized recommendations. Download music for offline listening with Premium.

apps.name: Google Drive
apps.summary: Store, share, and access your files from anywhere.
apps.description: Google Drive is a safe place to store all your files including photos, videos, and documents. Access files from any device, share with others, and collaborate in real-time on Docs, Sheets, and Slides. Get 15 GB of free storage.

apps.name: Duolingo
apps.summary: Learn 40+ languages with fun, bite-sized lessons.
apps.description: Duolingo is the fun, free app for learning 40+ languages through quick, bite-sized lessons. Practice speaking, reading, listening, and writing to build your vocabulary and grammar skills. Track your progress with rewards and achievements.

apps.name: NetEase Cloud Music
apps.summary: Discover and share music with a vibrant community.
apps.description: NetEase Cloud Music offers a massive library of songs with community-driven playlists, comments, and recommendations. Discover new music through personalized daily recommendations and connect with music lovers worldwide.

apps.name: Adobe Lightroom
apps.summary: Professional photo editor and camera.
apps.description: Adobe Lightroom is a powerful, free photo editor and camera app. Edit photos with advanced tools, apply presets, and use the built-in professional camera. Sync edits across all your devices with cloud storage.

apps.name: WeChat
apps.summary: Connect with friends and family worldwide.
apps.description: WeChat is a complete social communication app with messaging, voice and video calls, Moments, mini programs, and mobile payment. Connect with over 1.3 billion users worldwide for free.

apps.name: X (Twitter)
apps.summary: See what's happening in the world right now.
apps.description: X (formerly Twitter) is the place to see and join the global conversation. Follow your interests, share your thoughts, and connect with people around the world. Get breaking news, entertainment, sports, and more.

apps.name: TikTok
apps.summary: Short videos, endless entertainment.
apps.description: TikTok is the destination for short-form mobile videos. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Watch millions of videos, create your own content, and join a global community of creators.

apps.name: Calm
apps.summary: Sleep better, stress less, live mindfully.
apps.description: Calm is the #1 app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation. Join millions of people experiencing better sleep, lower stress, and less anxiety. Features guided meditations, sleep stories, breathing programs, and relaxing music.

apps.name: Evernote
apps.summary: Your notes, organized and synced everywhere.
apps.description: Evernote helps you capture and prioritize ideas, projects, and to-do lists, so nothing falls through the cracks. Sync across all devices, search text inside images and documents, and share with your team.

apps.name: Zoom
apps.summary: HD video meetings, chat, and collaboration.
apps.description: Zoom brings teams together with HD video, voice, chat, and content sharing. Host up to 1000 participants, use virtual backgrounds, and collaborate with screen sharing, whiteboard, and breakout rooms.

apps.name: DiDi
apps.summary: Ride-hailing, taxi, and mobility services.
apps.description: DiDi is the world's leading mobility platform. Book taxis, express cars, premium rides, and shared bikes. Get real-time driver tracking, estimated fares, and safe, reliable rides in hundreds of cities worldwide.

apps.name: PUBG Mobile
apps.summary: Battle royale, survive and be the last one standing.
apps.description: PUBG Mobile is the official battle royale game. Parachute onto an island, find weapons, and fight to be the last survivor. Features multiple maps, game modes, and seasonal events with stunning graphics.

apps.name: Snapchat
apps.summary: Share moments, make memories, have fun.
apps.description: Snapchat is a fast and fun way to share the moment with friends and family. Send disappearing photos and videos, use creative lenses and filters, chat with friends, and explore Stories and Spotlight.

apps.name: Tripadvisor
apps.summary: Plan and book your perfect trip.
apps.description: Tripadvisor helps you plan the perfect trip with millions of reviews and opinions from travelers worldwide. Find flights, hotels, restaurants, and things to do. Book tours and attractions with free cancellation.

apps.name: Minecraft
apps.summary: Build, explore, and survive in infinite worlds.
apps.description: Minecraft is an open-world game about placing blocks and going on adventures. Explore randomly generated worlds, build amazing structures from simple homes to grand castles, and survive against monsters in survival mode.

apps.name: Uber
apps.summary: Ride, earn, and eat with Uber.
apps.description: Uber is your one-stop app for rides, food delivery, and more. Request a ride in minutes, track your driver in real-time, and pay seamlessly. Also order food from your favorite restaurants with Uber Eats.

apps.name: Notion
apps.summary: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, and projects.
apps.description: Notion is the connected workspace where better, faster work happens. Bring your notes, docs, wikis, and projects together. Customize your workflow with drag-and-drop building blocks and collaborate in real-time.

apps.name: Microsoft Word
apps.summary: Create, edit, and share documents anywhere.
apps.description: Microsoft Word is the trusted word processor for creating, editing, and sharing documents. Collaborate in real-time, use rich formatting and templates, and access your files from any device with cloud integration.

apps.name: Canva
apps.summary: Design anything with ease.
apps.description: Canva makes design easy for everyone. Create stunning social media posts, presentations, posters, videos, logos, and more with thousands of free templates and design elements. No design experience needed.
